title: Saturation Genome Editing of PALB2 scores
methodText: Functional scores for SNVs and 3-bp deletions were calculated by applying a negative binomial regression model to variant counts across all sampled time points and replicates. Variants near 0 represent no change, loss of function variants have progressively more negative scores.
abstractText: We applied Saturation Genome Editing (SGE) to assess SNVs and in-frame deletions for their effect on cell survival and RNA expression.
shortDescription: We used saturation genome editing to measure the effect of SNVs and 3-base pair deletions on PALB2-dependent HAP1 cell survival.
